LESSON: SOCIAL AND NATIONAL FESTIVALS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: General
Strand: Utsav (Festivals)
Topic 8.1: Social and National Festivals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Social and National Festivals. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Social and National Festivals
2. Practise Social and National Festivals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Social and National Festivals

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Social and National Festivals
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Social and National Festivals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Social and National Festivals at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Social and National Festivals at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Social and National Festivals
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Social and National Festivals. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Social and National Festivals using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Social and National Festivals in the examples.
2. Explain Social and National Festivals to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Social and National Festivals.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Social and National Festivals using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Social and National Festivals important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Social and National Festivals
2. Practise Social and National Festivals at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Social and National Festivals

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
